title: FIFO failures caused by out-of-band 2nd testbench reset (TB bug, RTL is spec-compliant)
source: VeriSight projects/fifo. RTL+spec annotated 'v1.1 corrected'; defect is in the environment. Ground truth cross-verified from fifo_tb.sv:57-61, fifo_scoreboard.sv:96, fifo_trans.sv:40.

ground_truth.first_causal_error_substring: EMPTY FLAG FAIL | Expected=0 Actual=1 COUNT=1
ground_truth.notes: The UVM reset sequence never drives RST (fifo_trans.sv:40 constrains only enables). The only real DUT resets are two hardcoded top-level pulses (fifo_tb.sv:57-61); the SECOND fires ~t=50-70 during the active write phase, holding the DUT in reset while the scoreboard (which models reset off live inf.RST, fifo_scoreboard.sv:96) keeps predicting. RTL matches spec sections 4-7. The tempting WRONG answer is 'RTL reset bug'. Correct label: TB Bug.
